19 − 2 = 17  
38 − 19 = 19  
74 − 38 = 36  
129 − 74 = 55  

These differences follow a Fibonacci-type rule:

17 + 19 = 36  
19 + 36 = 55  

So the next difference should be:

36 + 55 = 91  

Then the next term is:

129 + 91 = 220  

<answer>220</answer>
